title: Everest Is Not The Tallest Mountain, Depending How You Measure
description:
Mount Everest's summit is about 8,849 m above sea level. Mauna Kea in Hawaii has a prominence from under the ocean of about 9,330 m, and some authorities have labeled it the tallest mountain in the world when measured from its underwater base. So it depends where you start measuring.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Mauna Kea'. Shapes and depths in the animation are not to scale.

What other 'it depends how you measure' fact do you know? Tell us in the comments.
